predecessors.name: Gilbert and Ellice Islands
predecessors.text: the Ellice Islands, now Tuvalu: three reef islands and six atolls

ledger.x: 1975: the Ellice Islands separate from the Gilbert Islands as the Crown colony of Tuvalu: 'The Tuvaluan Order 1975, which took effect on 1 October 1975'; the joint colony 'legally ceased to exist on 1 October 1975' and 'separate administrations followed on 1 January 1976' after the 1974 referendum.
1978: Tuvalu becomes independent: 'On 1 October 1978, Tuvalu became fully independent as a sovereign state within the Commonwealth.'

certainty.note: Nine small islands; the border is the coast.
